title: Lantern Shore
summary: The arrival point where a person learns what Calypso’s Promise is and chooses whether to begin.
publicPurpose: Explain the product, its limits, and the player’s choices before account creation or personal data collection.
inWorldPurpose: The Castaway awakens, meets Aster, reads Calypso’s message, and decides whether to approach Ogygia.
accessibilityNotes: The complete explanation must be available without animation.
All choices must be keyboard and screen-reader accessible.
Leaving must be as visible and functional as continuing.
